note: Recorded corrections between scripts/audit-code.py and SRW for Starsiege: Tribes 1.41. The image has no relocation table, so the audit's pointer guesses need these. Each entry gives its evidence.

not_code.why: only reference is 0x631514, inside a table of 16-bit values; decoding there misaligns the unwind funclet at 0x60002A
references at 0x674684, 0x674A84, 0x675044, 0x675444 are numeric table data; 0x600800 is the middle of a call

code.why: C++ unwind funclet (mov ecx,[ebp-0x10]; add ecx,0x4B0; jmp) referenced from the unwind table at 0x6AA430

instruction_replacements.why: jnz to 0x52BC65 when DirectInputCreateA fails; the community 1.41 patch overwrote the target with other code, so the branch leads into the middle of an instruction even on Windows. Trap loudly if taken.
instruction_replacements.llasm: ;jnz loc_52BC65 (overwritten target)|and tmp1, eflags, ZF|ctcallz tmp1, hp_trap_52BC4F|tcall hp_loc_52BC51|endp|proc hp_trap_52BC4F|call halopad_trap_unimplemented 0x52bc4f|tcall hp_loc_52BC51|endp|proc hp_loc_52BC51
